# GINKVORA
> GINKVORA is a certified B2B supplier of high-purity botanical and bioactive raw materials for the cosmetic and health industries. We supply bulk active ingredients including NMN, PDRN, and Glabridin with full batch testing documentation and advanced liposomal delivery systems.

## About & Quality Standards
- [About GINKVORA](https://ginkvora.com/about) : Overview of our company mission, B2B sourcing network, and clinical research partnerships.
- [Quality & Manufacturing](https://ginkvora.com/quality) : Details on our state-of-the-art GMP manufacturing facilities, ISO 9001:2015 certifications, and analytical testing laboratories.
- [Anti-Aging Philosophy](https://ginkvora.com/anti-aging-philosophy) : Scientific review of how our active ingredients target key Extracellular Matrix (ECM) pathways for cellular longevity and skin health.

## Core Products & Ingredients
- [All Products Directory](https://ginkvora.com/products) : The complete catalogue of GINKVORA's botanical extracts and longevity ingredients.
- [PQQ (Pyrroloquinoline Quinone Disodium Salt)](https://ginkvora.com/products/pqq-disodium-salt) : ≥99% purity mitochondrial optimizer for cellular energy and cognitive health formulations.
- [NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)](https://ginkvora.com/products/nmn-nicotinamide-mononucleotide) : ≥99% pure NAD+ precursor for anti-aging and DNA repair supplements.
- [EGCG (Epigallocatechin Gallate)](https://ginkvora.com/products/egcg-epigallocatechin-gallate) : ≥98% purity green tea extract active for metabolic, cellular, and skin health.
- [Glabridin](https://ginkvora.com/products/glabridin) : Premium cosmetic active extract for whitening, pigmentation control, and anti-inflammatory skincare.
- [GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1)](https://ginkvora.com/products/copper-tripeptide-1-ghk-cu-hydrochloride) : High-stability peptide active supporting collagen synthesis and skin barrier remodeling.
- [Quercetin](https://ginkvora.com/products/quercetin) : Plant-derived antioxidant and senolytic active for immune support and anti-inflammatory applications.

## Specialized Technologies
- [Custom Formulation Services](https://ginkvora.com/custom-formulation) : Custom research and development solutions for specialized botanical delivery systems.
- [Liposomal Delivery Systems](https://ginkvora.com/products?category=liposomal) : Bioavailability-enhanced active ingredients utilizing advanced lipid bilayer encapsulation.
- [Oral Dissolving Film (ODF/OTF)](https://ginkvora.com/custom-formulation) : Rapid-dissolve sublingual thin-film technology for maximum active absorption.
